verses.original: לַמְנַצֵּ֤חַ׀ לְעֶ֥בֶד יְהוָ֗ה לְדָ֫וִ֥ד אֲשֶׁ֤ר דִּבֶּ֨ר׀ לַיהוָ֗ה אֶת־ דִּ֭בְרֵי הַשִּׁירָ֣ה הַזֹּ֑את בְּי֤וֹם הִֽצִּיל־ יְהוָ֘ה אוֹת֥וֹ מִכַּ֥ף כָּל־ אֹ֝יְבָ֗יו וּמִיַּ֥ד שָׁאֽוּל׃ וַיֹּאמַ֡ר אֶרְחָמְךָ֖ יְהוָ֣ה חִזְקִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: lam·naṣ·ṣê·aḥ lə·‘e·ḇeḏ Yah·weh lə·ḏā·wiḏ ’ă·šer dib·ber Yah·weh ’eṯ- diḇ·rê haš·šî·rāh haz·zōṯ bə·yō·wm hiṣ·ṣîl- Yah·weh ’ō·w·ṯōw mik·kap̄ kāl- ’ō·yə·ḇāw ū·mî·yaḏ šā·’ūl way·yō·mar ’er·ḥā·mə·ḵā Yah·weh ḥiz·qî
verses.literal: For the choirmaster Of David the servant of the LORD who sang - this song to the LORD on the day the LORD had delivered him from the hand of all his enemies and from the hand of Saul He said I love You O LORD my strength
verses.literalPt: EU te amarei, ó SENHOR, fortaleza minha.

verses.original: יְהוָ֤ה׀ סַֽלְעִ֥י וּמְצוּדָתִ֗י וּמְפַ֫לְטִ֥י אֵלִ֣י צ֭וּרִי אֶֽחֱסֶה־ בּ֑וֹ מָֽגִנִּ֥י וְקֶֽרֶן־ יִ֝שְׁעִ֗י מִשְׂגַּבִּֽי׃
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh sal·‘î ū·mə·ṣū·ḏā·ṯî ū·mə·p̄al·ṭî ’ê·lî ṣū·rî ’e·ḥĕ·seh- bōw mā·ḡin·nî wə·qe·ren- yiš·‘î miś·gab·bî
verses.literal: The LORD is my rock my fortress and my deliverer My God is my rock in whom I take refuge my shield and the horn of my salvation my stronghold
verses.literalPt: O SENHOR é o meu rochedo, e o meu lugar forte, e o meu libertador; o meu Deus, a minha fortaleza, em quem confio; o meu escudo, a força da minha salvação, e o meu alto refúgio.

verses.original: מְ֭הֻלָּל אֶקְרָ֣א יְהוָ֑ה וּמִן־ אֹ֝יְבַ֗י אִוָּשֵֽׁעַ׃
verses.transliteration: mə·hul·lāl ’eq·rā Yah·weh ū·min- ’ō·yə·ḇay ’iw·wā·šê·a‘
verses.literal: I will call upon the LORD who is worthy to be praised so shall I be saved from my enemies
verses.literalPt: Invocarei o nome do SENHOR, que é digno de louvor, e ficarei livre dos meus inimigos.

verses.original: אֲפָפ֥וּנִי חֶבְלֵי־ מָ֑וֶת וְֽנַחֲלֵ֖י בְלִיַּ֣עַל יְבַֽעֲתֽוּנִי׃
verses.transliteration: ’ă·p̄ā·p̄ū·nî ḥeḇ·lê- mā·weṯ wə·na·ḥă·lê ḇə·lî·ya·‘al yə·ḇa·‘ă·ṯū·nî
verses.literal: The cords of death encompassed me the torrents of chaos overwhelmed me
verses.literalPt: Tristezas de morte me cercaram, e torrentes de impiedade me assombraram.

verses.original: חֶבְלֵ֣י שְׁא֣וֹל סְבָב֑וּנִי קִ֝דְּמ֗וּנִי מ֣וֹקְשֵׁי מָֽוֶת׃
verses.transliteration: ḥeḇ·lê šə·’ō·wl sə·ḇā·ḇū·nî qid·də·mū·nî mō·wq·šê mā·weṯ
verses.literal: The cords of Sheol entangled me the snares of death confronted me
verses.literalPt: Tristezas do inferno me cingiram, laços de morte me surpreenderam.

verses.original: בַּצַּר־ לִ֤י׀ אֶֽקְרָ֣א יְהוָה֮ וְאֶל־ אֱלֹהַ֪י אֲשַׁ֫וֵּ֥עַ יִשְׁמַ֣ע מֵהֵיכָל֣וֹ קוֹלִ֑י וְ֝שַׁוְעָתִ֗י לְפָנָ֤יו׀ תָּב֬וֹא בְאָזְנָֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: baṣ·ṣar- lî ’eq·rā Yah·weh wə·’el- ’ĕ·lō·hay ’ă·šaw·wê·a‘ yiš·ma‘ mê·hê·ḵā·lōw qō·w·lî wə·šaw·‘ā·ṯî lə·p̄ā·nāw tā·ḇō·w ḇə·’ā·zə·nāw
verses.literal: In my distress I called upon the LORD I cried to my God for help From His temple He heard my voice and my cry for His help . . . reached His ears
verses.literalPt: Na angústia invoquei ao SENHOR, e clamei ao meu Deus; desde o seu templo ouviu a minha voz, aos seus ouvidos chegou o meu clamor perante a sua face.

verses.original: וַתִּגְעַ֬שׁ וַתִּרְעַ֨שׁ׀ הָאָ֗רֶץ וּמוֹסְדֵ֣י הָרִ֣ים יִרְגָּ֑זוּ וַ֝יִּתְגָּֽעֲשׁ֗וּ כִּי־ חָ֥רָה לֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: wat·tiḡ·‘aš wat·tir·‘aš hā·’ā·reṣ ū·mō·ws·ḏê hā·rîm yir·gā·zū way·yiṯ·gā·‘ă·šū kî- ḥā·rāh lōw
verses.literal: Then the earth shook and quaked and the foundations of the mountains trembled they were shaken because He burned with anger
verses.literalPt: Então a terra se abalou e tremeu; e os fundamentos dos montes também se moveram e se abalaram, porquanto se indignou.

verses.original: עָ֘לָ֤ה עָשָׁ֨ן׀ בְּאַפּ֗וֹ וְאֵשׁ־ מִפִּ֥יו תֹּאכֵ֑ל גֶּ֝חָלִ֗ים בָּעֲר֥וּ מִמֶּֽנּוּ׃
verses.transliteration: ‘ā·lāh ‘ā·šān bə·’ap·pōw wə·’êš- mip·pîw tō·ḵêl ge·ḥā·lîm bā·‘ă·rū mim·men·nū
verses.literal: Smoke rose from His nostrils and consuming fire came from His mouth glowing coals blazed forth
verses.literalPt: Das suas narinas subiu fumaça, e da sua boca saiu fogo que consumia; carvões se acenderam dele.

verses.original: וַיֵּ֣ט שָׁ֭מַיִם וַיֵּרַ֑ד וַ֝עֲרָפֶ֗ל תַּ֣חַת רַגְלָֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: way·yêṭ šā·ma·yim way·yê·raḏ wa·‘ă·rā·p̄el ta·ḥaṯ raḡ·lāw
verses.literal: He parted the heavens and came down with dark clouds beneath His feet
verses.literalPt: Abaixou os céus, e desceu, e a escuridão estava debaixo de seus pés.

verses.original: וַיִּרְכַּ֣ב עַל־ כְּ֭רוּב וַיָּעֹ֑ף וַ֝יֵּ֗דֶא עַל־ כַּנְפֵי־ רֽוּחַ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yir·kaḇ ‘al- kə·rūḇ way·yā·‘ōp̄ way·yê·ḏe ‘al- kan·p̄ê- rū·aḥ
verses.literal: He mounted . . . a cherub and flew He soared on the wings of the wind
verses.literalPt: E montou num querubim, e voou; sim, voou sobre as asas do vento.

verses.original: יָ֤שֶׁת חֹ֨שֶׁךְ׀ סִתְר֗וֹ סְבִֽיבוֹתָ֥יו סֻכָּת֑וֹ חֶשְׁכַת־ מַ֝֗יִם עָבֵ֥י שְׁחָקִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: yā·šeṯ ḥō·šeḵ siṯ·rōw sə·ḇî·ḇō·w·ṯāw suk·kā·ṯōw ḥeš·ḵaṯ- ma·yim ‘ā·ḇê šə·ḥā·qîm
verses.literal: He made darkness His hiding place and storm clouds a canopy . . . around Him
verses.literalPt: Fez das trevas o seu lugar oculto; o pavilhão que o cercava era a escuridão das águas e as nuvens dos céus.

verses.original: מִנֹּ֗גַהּ נֶ֫גְדּ֥וֹ עָבָ֥יו עָבְר֑וּ בָּ֝רָ֗ד וְגַֽחֲלֵי־ אֵֽשׁ׃
verses.transliteration: min·nō·ḡah neḡ·dōw ‘ā·ḇāw ‘ā·ḇə·rū bā·rāḏ wə·ḡa·ḥă·lê- ’êš
verses.literal: From the brightness of His presence His clouds advanced hailstones and coals of fire
verses.literalPt: Ao resplendor da sua presença as nuvens se espalharam, e a saraiva e as brasas de fogo.

verses.original: וַיַּרְעֵ֬ם בַּשָּׁמַ֨יִם׀ יְֽהוָ֗ה וְ֭עֶלְיוֹן יִתֵּ֣ן קֹל֑וֹ בָּ֝רָ֗ד וְגַֽחֲלֵי־ אֵֽשׁ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yar·‘êm baš·šā·ma·yim Yah·weh wə·‘el·yō·wn yit·tên qō·lōw bā·rāḏ wə·ḡa·ḥă·lê- ’êš
verses.literal: The LORD thundered from heaven the voice of the Most High resounded hailstones and coals of fire
verses.literalPt: E o SENHOR trovejou nos céus, o Altíssimo levantou a sua voz; e houve saraiva e brasas de fogo.

verses.original: וַיִּשְׁלַ֣ח חִ֭צָּיו וַיְפִיצֵ֑ם וּבְרָקִ֥ים רָ֝ב וַיְהֻמֵּֽם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiš·laḥ ḥiṣ·ṣāw way·p̄î·ṣêm ū·ḇə·rā·qîm rāḇ way·hum·mêm
verses.literal: He shot His arrows and scattered the foes He hurled lightning and routed them
verses.literalPt: Mandou as suas setas, e as espalhou; multiplicou raios, e os desbaratou.

verses.original: וַיֵּ֤רָא֨וּ׀ אֲפִ֥יקֵי מַ֗יִם וַֽיִּגָּלוּ֮ מוֹסְד֪וֹת תֵּ֫בֵ֥ל מִגַּעֲרָ֣תְךָ֣ יְהוָ֑ה מִ֝נִּשְׁמַ֗ת ר֣וּחַ אַפֶּֽךָ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yê·rā·’ū ’ă·p̄î·qê ma·yim way·yig·gā·lū mō·ws·ḏō·wṯ tê·ḇêl mig·ga·‘ă·rā·ṯə·ḵā Yah·weh min·niš·maṯ rū·aḥ ’ap·pe·ḵā
verses.literal: The channels of the sea appeared and the foundations of the world were exposed at Your rebuke O LORD at the blast of the breath of Your nostrils
verses.literalPt: Então foram vistas as profundezas das águas, e foram descobertos os fundamentos do mundo, pela tua repreensão, SENHOR, ao sopro das tuas narinas.

verses.original: יִשְׁלַ֣ח מִ֭מָּרוֹם יִקָּחֵ֑נִי יַֽ֝מְשֵׁ֗נִי מִמַּ֥יִם רַבִּֽים׃
verses.transliteration: yiš·laḥ mim·mā·rō·wm yiq·qā·ḥê·nî yam·šê·nî mim·ma·yim rab·bîm
verses.literal: He reached down from on high and took hold of me He drew me out of deep waters
verses.literalPt: Enviou desde o alto, e me tomou; tirou-me das muitas águas.

verses.original: יַצִּילֵ֗נִי מֵאֹיְבִ֥י עָ֑ז וּ֝מִשֹּׂנְאַ֗י כִּֽי־ אָמְצ֥וּ מִמֶּֽנִּי׃
verses.transliteration: yaṣ·ṣî·lê·nî mê·’ō·yə·ḇî ‘āz ū·miś·śō·nə·’ay kî- ’ā·mə·ṣū mim·men·nî
verses.literal: He rescued me from my powerful enemy from foes too mighty for me
verses.literalPt: Livrou-me do meu inimigo forte e dos que me odiavam, pois eram mais poderosos do que eu.

verses.original: יְקַדְּמ֥וּנִי בְיוֹם־ אֵידִ֑י וַֽיְהִי־ יְהוָ֖ה לְמִשְׁעָ֣ן לִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: yə·qad·də·mū·nî ḇə·yō·wm- ’ê·ḏî way·hî- Yah·weh lə·miš·‘ān lî
verses.literal: They confronted me in my day of calamity but the LORD was my support
verses.literalPt: Surpreenderam-me no dia da minha calamidade; mas o SENHOR foi o meu amparo.

verses.original: וַיּוֹצִיאֵ֥נִי לַמֶּרְחָ֑ב יְ֝חַלְּצֵ֗נִי כִּ֘י חָ֥פֵֽץ בִּֽי׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·w·ṣî·’ê·nî lam·mer·ḥāḇ yə·ḥal·lə·ṣê·nî kî ḥā·p̄êṣ bî
verses.literal: He brought me out into the open He rescued me because He delighted in me
verses.literalPt: Trouxe-me para um lugar espaçoso; livrou-me, porque tinha prazer em mim.

verses.original: יִגְמְלֵ֣נִי יְהוָ֣ה כְּצִדְקִ֑י כְּבֹ֥ר יָ֝דַ֗י יָשִׁ֥יב לִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: yiḡ·mə·lê·nî Yah·weh kə·ṣiḏ·qî kə·ḇōr yā·ḏay yā·šîḇ lî
verses.literal: The LORD has rewarded me according to my righteousness He has repaid me according to the cleanness of my hands
verses.literalPt: Recompensou-me o SENHOR conforme a minha justiça, retribuiu-me conforme a pureza das minhas mãos.

verses.original: כִּֽי־ שָׁ֭מַרְתִּי דַּרְכֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה וְלֹֽא־ רָ֝שַׁ֗עְתִּי מֵאֱלֹהָֽי׃
verses.transliteration: kî·šā- šā·mar·tî dar·ḵê Yah·weh wə·lō- rā·ša‘·tî mê·’ĕ·lō·hāy
verses.literal: For I have kept the ways of the LORD and have not wickedly departed from my God
verses.literalPt: Porque guardei os caminhos do SENHOR, e não me apartei impiamente do meu Deus.

verses.original: כִּ֣י כָל־ מִשְׁפָּטָ֣יו לְנֶגְדִּ֑י וְ֝חֻקֹּתָ֗יו לֹא־ אָסִ֥יר מֶֽנִּי׃
verses.transliteration: kî ḵāl miš·pā·ṭāw lə·neḡ·dî wə·ḥuq·qō·ṯāw lō- ’ā·sîr men·nî
verses.literal: For all His ordinances are before me I have not disregarded . . . His statutes
verses.literalPt: Porque todos os seus juízos estavam diante de mim, e não rejeitei os seus estatutos.

verses.original: וָאֱהִ֣י תָמִ֣ים עִמּ֑וֹ וָ֝אֶשְׁתַּמֵּ֗ר מֵעֲוֺנִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: wā·’ĕ·hî ṯā·mîm ‘im·mōw wā·’eš·tam·mêr mê·‘ă·wō·nî
verses.literal: And I have been blameless before Him and kept myself from iniquity
verses.literalPt: Também fui sincero perante ele, e me guardei da minha iniqüidade.

verses.original: וַיָּֽשֶׁב־ יְהוָ֣ה לִ֣י כְצִדְקִ֑י כְּבֹ֥ר יָ֝דַ֗י לְנֶ֣גֶד עֵינָֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·šeḇ- Yah·weh lî ḵə·ṣiḏ·qî kə·ḇōr yā·ḏay lə·ne·ḡeḏ ‘ê·nāw
verses.literal: So the LORD has repaid me according to my righteousness according to the cleanness of my hands in His sight
verses.literalPt: Assim que retribuiu-me o SENHOR conforme a minha justiça, conforme a pureza de minhas mãos perante os seus olhos.

verses.original: עִם־ חָסִ֥יד תִּתְחַסָּ֑ד עִם־ גְּבַ֥ר תָּ֝מִ֗ים תִּתַּמָּֽם׃
verses.transliteration: ‘im- ḥā·sîḏ tiṯ·ḥas·sāḏ ‘im- gə·ḇar tā·mîm tit·tam·mām
verses.literal: To the faithful You show Yourself faithful to . . . the blameless You show Yourself blameless
verses.literalPt: Com o benigno te mostrarás benigno; e com o homem sincero te mostrarás sincero;

verses.original: עִם־ נָבָ֥ר תִּתְבָּרָ֑ר וְעִם־ עִ֝קֵּ֗שׁ תִּתְפַּתָּֽל׃
verses.transliteration: ‘im- nā·ḇār tiṯ·bā·rār wə·‘im- ‘iq·qêš tiṯ·pat·tāl
verses.literal: to the pure You show Yourself pure but to the crooked You show Yourself shrewd
verses.literalPt: Com o puro te mostrarás puro; e com o perverso te mostrarás indomável.

verses.original: כִּֽי־ אַ֭תָּה עַם־ עָנִ֣י תוֹשִׁ֑יעַ וְעֵינַ֖יִם רָמ֣וֹת תַּשְׁפִּֽיל׃
verses.transliteration: kî- ’at·tāh ‘am- ‘ā·nî ṯō·wō·šî·a‘ wə·‘ê·na·yim rā·mō·wṯ taš·pîl
verses.literal: For You save an afflicted people but You humble those with haughty eyes
verses.literalPt: Porque tu livrarás o povo aflito, e abaterás os olhos altivos.

verses.original: כִּֽי־ אַ֭תָּה תָּאִ֣יר נֵרִ֑י יְהוָ֥ה אֱ֝לֹהַ֗י יַגִּ֥יהַּ חָשְׁכִּֽי׃
verses.transliteration: kî- ’at·tāh tā·’îr nê·rî Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hay yag·gî·ah ḥā·šə·kî
verses.literal: For You O LORD light my lamp my God lights up my darkness
verses.literalPt: Porque tu acenderás a minha candeia; o SENHOR meu Deus iluminará as minhas trevas.

verses.original: כִּֽי־ בְ֭ךָ אָרֻ֣ץ גְּד֑וּד וּ֝בֵֽאלֹהַ֗י אֲדַלֶּג־ שֽׁוּר׃
verses.transliteration: kî- ḇə·ḵā ’ā·ruṣ gə·ḏūḏ ū·ḇê·lō·hay ’ă·ḏal·leḡ- šūr
verses.literal: For in You I can charge an army and with my God I can scale a wall
verses.literalPt: Porque contigo entrei pelo meio duma tropa, com o meu Deus saltei uma muralha.

verses.original: הָאֵל֮ תָּמִ֪ים דַּ֫רְכּ֥וֹ אִמְרַֽת־ יְהוָ֥ה צְרוּפָ֑ה מָגֵ֥ן ה֝֗וּא לְכֹ֤ל׀ הַחֹסִ֬ים בּֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: hā·’êl tā·mîm dar·kōw ’im·raṯ- Yah·weh ṣə·rū·p̄āh mā·ḡên hū lə·ḵōl ha·ḥō·sîm bōw
verses.literal: As for God His way is perfect the word of the LORD is flawless He is a shield to all who take refuge in Him
verses.literalPt: O caminho de Deus é perfeito; a palavra do SENHOR é provada; é um escudo para todos os que nele confiam.

verses.original: כִּ֤י מִ֣י אֱ֭לוֹהַּ מִבַּלְעֲדֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה וּמִ֥י צ֝֗וּר זוּלָתִ֥י אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ׃
verses.transliteration: kî mî ’ĕ·lō·w·ah mib·bal·‘ă·ḏê Yah·weh ū·mî ṣūr zū·lā·ṯî ’ĕ·lō·hê·nū
verses.literal: For who is God besides the LORD And who is the Rock except our God
verses.literalPt: Porque quem é Deus senão o SENHOR? E quem é rochedo senão o nosso Deus?

verses.original: הָ֭אֵל הַמְאַזְּרֵ֣נִי חָ֑יִל וַיִּתֵּ֖ן תָּמִ֣ים דַּרְכִּֽי׃
verses.transliteration: hā·’êl ham·’az·zə·rê·nî ḥā·yil way·yit·tên tā·mîm dar·kî
verses.literal: It is God who arms me with strength and makes my way clear
verses.literalPt: Deus é o que me cinge de força e aperfeiçoa o meu caminho.

verses.original: מְשַׁוֶּ֣ה רַ֭גְלַי כָּאַיָּל֑וֹת וְעַ֥ל בָּ֝מֹתַ֗י יַעֲמִידֵֽנִי׃
verses.transliteration: mə·šaw·weh raḡ·lay kā·’ay·yā·lō·wṯ wə·‘al bā·mō·ṯay ya·‘ă·mî·ḏê·nî
verses.literal: He makes my feet like those of a deer and stations me upon the heights
verses.literalPt: Faz os meus pés como os das cervas, e põe-me nas minhas alturas.

verses.original: מְלַמֵּ֣ד יָ֭דַי לַמִּלְחָמָ֑ה וְֽנִחֲתָ֥ה קֶֽשֶׁת־ נְ֝חוּשָׁ֗ה זְרוֹעֹתָֽי׃
verses.transliteration: mə·lam·mêḏ yā·ḏay lam·mil·ḥā·māh wə·ni·ḥă·ṯāh qe·šeṯ- nə·ḥū·šāh zə·rō·w·‘ō·ṯāy
verses.literal: He trains my hands for battle my arms can bend a bow of bronze
verses.literalPt: Ensina as minhas mãos para a guerra, de sorte que os meus braços quebraram um arco de cobre.

verses.original: וַתִּתֶּן־ לִי֮ מָגֵ֪ן יִ֫שְׁעֶ֥ךָ וִֽימִינְךָ֥ תִסְעָדֵ֑נִי וְֽעַנְוַתְךָ֥ תַרְבֵּֽנִי׃
verses.transliteration: wat·tit·ten- lî mā·ḡên yiš·‘e·ḵā wî·mî·nə·ḵā ṯis·‘ā·ḏê·nî wə·‘an·waṯ·ḵā ṯar·bê·nî
verses.literal: You have given me Your shield of salvation Your right hand upholds me and Your gentleness exalts me
verses.literalPt: Também me deste o escudo da tua salvação; a tua mão direita me susteve, e a tua mansidão me engrandeceu.

verses.original: תַּרְחִ֣יב צַעֲדִ֣י תַחְתָּ֑י וְלֹ֥א מָ֝עֲד֗וּ קַרְסֻלָּֽי׃
verses.transliteration: tar·ḥîḇ ṣa·‘ă·ḏî ṯaḥ·tāy wə·lō mā·‘ă·ḏū qar·sul·lāy
verses.literal: You broaden the path beneath me so that my ankles do not give way
verses.literalPt: Alargaste os meus passos debaixo de mim, de maneira que os meus artelhos não vacilaram.

verses.original: אֶרְדּ֣וֹף א֭וֹיְבַי וְאַשִּׂיגֵ֑ם וְלֹֽא־ אָ֝שׁוּב עַד־ כַּלּוֹתָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: ’er·dō·wp̄ ’ō·wy·ḇay wə·’aś·śî·ḡêm wə·lō- ʾå̄·šūḇ ‘aḏ- kal·lō·w·ṯām
verses.literal: I pursued my enemies and overtook them I did not turn back until they were consumed
verses.literalPt: Persegui os meus inimigos, e os alcancei; não voltei senão depois de os ter consumido.

verses.original: אֶ֭מְחָצֵם וְלֹא־ יֻ֣כְלוּ ק֑וּם יִ֝פְּל֗וּ תַּ֣חַת רַגְלָֽי׃
verses.transliteration: ’em·ḥā·ṣêm wə·lō- yuḵ·lū qūm yip·pə·lū ta·ḥaṯ raḡ·lāy
verses.literal: I crushed them so they could not . . . rise they have fallen under my feet
verses.literalPt: Atravessei-os de sorte que não se puderam levantar; caíram debaixo dos meus pés.

verses.original: וַתְּאַזְּרֵ֣נִי חַ֭יִל לַמִּלְחָמָ֑ה תַּכְרִ֖יעַ קָמַ֣י תַּחְתָּֽי׃
verses.transliteration: wat·tə·’az·zə·rê·nî ḥa·yil lam·mil·ḥā·māh taḵ·rî·a‘ qā·may taḥ·tāy
verses.literal: You have armed me with strength for battle You have subdued my foes beneath me
verses.literalPt: Pois me cingiste de força para a peleja; fizeste abater debaixo de mim aqueles que contra mim se levantaram.

verses.original: וְֽאֹיְבַ֗י נָתַ֣תָּה לִּ֣י עֹ֑רֶף וּ֝מְשַׂנְאַ֗י אַצְמִיתֵֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’ō·yə·ḇay nā·ṯat·tāh lî ‘ō·rep̄ ū·mə·śan·’ay ’aṣ·mî·ṯêm
verses.literal: You have made my enemies retreat before me I destroyed those who hated me
verses.literalPt: Deste-me também o pescoço dos meus inimigos para que eu pudesse destruir os que me odeiam.

verses.original: יְשַׁוְּע֥וּ וְאֵין־ מוֹשִׁ֑יעַ עַל־ יְ֝הוָ֗ה וְלֹ֣א עָנָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: yə·šaw·wə·‘ū wə·’ên- mō·wō·šî·a‘ ‘al- Yah·weh wə·lō ‘ā·nām
verses.literal: They cried for help but there was no one to save them to the LORD but He did not answer
verses.literalPt: Clamaram, mas não houve quem os livrasse; até ao SENHOR, mas ele não lhes respondeu.

verses.original: וְֽאֶשְׁחָקֵ֗ם כְּעָפָ֥ר עַל־ פְּנֵי־ ר֑וּחַ כְּטִ֖יט חוּצ֣וֹת אֲרִיקֵֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’eš·ḥā·qêm kə·‘ā·p̄ār ‘al- pə·nê- rū·aḥ kə·ṭîṭ ḥū·ṣō·wṯ ’ă·rî·qêm
verses.literal: I ground them as dust in the face of the wind I trampled them like mud in the streets
verses.literalPt: Então os esmiucei como o pó diante do vento; deitei-os fora como a lama das ruas.

verses.original: תְּפַלְּטֵנִי֮ מֵרִ֪יבֵ֫י עָ֥ם תְּ֭שִׂימֵנִי לְרֹ֣אשׁ גּוֹיִ֑ם עַ֖ם לֹא־ יָדַ֣עְתִּי יַֽעַבְדֽוּנִי׃
verses.transliteration: tə·p̄al·lə·ṭê·nî mê·rî·ḇê ‘ām tə·śî·mê·nî lə·rōš gō·w·yim ‘am lō- yā·ḏa‘·tî ya·‘aḇ·ḏū·nî
verses.literal: You have delivered me from the strife of the people You have made me the head of nations a people I had not known shall serve me
verses.literalPt: Livraste-me das contendas do povo, e me fizeste cabeça dos gentios; um povo que não conheci me servirá.

verses.original: לְשֵׁ֣מַֽע אֹ֭זֶן יִשָּׁ֣מְעוּ לִ֑י בְּנֵֽי־ נֵ֝כָ֗ר יְכַחֲשׁוּ־ לִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: lə·šê·ma‘ ’ō·zen yiš·šā·mə·‘ū lî bə·nê- nê·ḵār yə·ḵa·ḥă·šū- lî
verses.literal: When they hear me . . . they obey me foreigners . . . cower before me
verses.literalPt: Em ouvindo a minha voz, me obedecerão; os estranhos se submeterão a mim.

verses.original: בְּנֵי־ נֵכָ֥ר יִבֹּ֑לוּ וְ֝יַחְרְג֗וּ מִֽמִּסְגְּרֽוֹתֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: bə·nê- nê·ḵār yib·bō·lū wə·yaḥ·rə·ḡū mim·mis·gə·rō·w·ṯê·hem
verses.literal: Foreigners . . . lose heart and come trembling from their strongholds
verses.literalPt: Os estranhos descairão, e terão medo nos seus esconderijos.

verses.original: חַי־ יְ֭הוָה וּבָר֣וּךְ צוּרִ֑י וְ֝יָר֗וּם אֱלוֹהֵ֥י יִשְׁעִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: ḥay- Yah·weh ū·ḇā·rūḵ ṣū·rî wə·yā·rūm ’ĕ·lō·w·hê yiš·‘î
verses.literal: The LORD lives and blessed be my Rock And may the God of my salvation be exalted
verses.literalPt: O SENHOR vive; e bendito seja o meu rochedo, e exaltado seja o Deus da minha salvação.

verses.original: הָאֵ֗ל הַנּוֹתֵ֣ן נְקָמ֣וֹת לִ֑י וַיַּדְבֵּ֖ר עַמִּ֣ים תַּחְתָּֽי׃
verses.transliteration: hā·’êl han·nō·w·ṯên nə·qā·mō·wṯ lî way·yaḏ·bêr ‘am·mîm taḥ·tāy
verses.literal: the God who avenges . . . me and subdues nations beneath me
verses.literalPt: É Deus que me vinga inteiramente, e sujeita os povos debaixo de mim;

verses.original: מְפַלְּטִ֗י מֵאֹ֫יְבָ֥י אַ֣ף מִן־ קָ֭מַי תְּרוֹמְמֵ֑נִי מֵאִ֥ישׁ חָ֝מָ֗ס תַּצִּילֵֽנִי׃
verses.transliteration: mə·p̄al·lə·ṭî mê·’ō·yə·ḇāy ’ap̄ min- qā·may tə·rō·wm·mê·nî mê·’îš ḥā·mās taṣ·ṣî·lê·nî
verses.literal: who delivers me from my enemies . . . You exalt me above my foes You rescue me from violent men
verses.literalPt: O que me livra de meus inimigos; sim, tu me exaltas sobre os que se levantam contra mim, tu me livras do homem violento.

verses.original: עַל־ כֵּ֤ן׀ אוֹדְךָ֖ בַגּוֹיִ֥ם׀ יְהוָ֑ה וּלְשִׁמְךָ֥ אֲזַמֵּֽרָה׃
verses.transliteration: ‘al- kên ’ō·wḏ·ḵā ḇag·gō·w·yim Yah·weh ū·lə·šim·ḵā ’ă·zam·mê·rāh
verses.literal: Therefore . . . I will praise You O LORD among the nations I will sing praises to Your name
verses.literalPt: Assim que, ó SENHOR, te louvarei entre os gentios, e cantarei louvores ao teu nome,

verses.original: מַגְדִּל יְשׁוּע֪וֹת מַ֫לְכּ֥וֹ וְעֹ֤שֶׂה חֶ֨סֶד׀ לִמְשִׁיח֗וֹ לְדָוִ֥ד וּלְזַרְע֗וֹ עַד־ עוֹלָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: maḡ·dil yə·šū·‘ō·wṯ mal·kōw wə·‘ō·śeh ḥe·seḏ lim·šî·ḥōw lə·ḏā·wiḏ ū·lə·zar·‘ōw ‘aḏ- ‘ō·w·lām
verses.literal: Great salvation He brings to His king He shows loving devotion to His anointed to David and his descendants forever . . .
verses.literalPt: Pois engrandece a salvação do seu rei, e usa de benignidade com o seu ungido, com Davi, e com a sua semente para sempre.
